verdict.rationale: telli's built-in AI assistant Charlie is documented as able to "analyze your calls" and help refine agents, which points to AI-generated insights from in-product call data. Metrics dashboards and call/transcript analysis provide the data surface, but the docs never describe what insights or suggestions Charlie actually produces. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations (e.g., summaries, trend detection, suggested agent improvements), any example output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
